info.description: HTTP API for identifying facility information at a selected geographic location. The API guide documents version v1.0.0; the OpenAPI metadata version is a placeholder and is not a publisher API version. Avoid invoking the API with large numbers of requests within a short period. Authentication requirements are not specified in the source.
info.title: Lands Department Identify API

get.description: Identifies information about a facility at the selected geographic location. The documented current API version is v1.0.0; the publisher notes that versions may be updated and old versions may be removed without notice. The response is JSON, but the source does not document its object structure.

parameters.description: API version. The guide identifies v1.0.0 as the current version and warns that supported versions may change.
parameters.name: version

parameters.description: HK80 Easting coordinate value, in metres. The guide does not explicitly label query requiredness.
parameters.name: x

parameters.description: HK80 Northing coordinate value, in metres. The guide does not explicitly label query requiredness.
parameters.name: y

parameters.description: Language of the output JSON. The guide documents en for English and zh for Traditional Chinese. The guide does not explicitly label query requiredness.
parameters.name: lang

200.description: OK. Response data is returned in JSON format; the response structure is not documented.

400.description: Bad Request, for example because of invalid query parameters.
